partnership_angle: Referral partner + sandbox tester — the archetype fit. The firm is founder-led, ~10-15 people, exists specifically to do fast SOC 2 for small/startup tech companies, and its whole operating model is built on GRC automation (Certified Vanta Partner, staff full of ex-Vanta people, dedicated Director of Partnerships in Peter Case). Crucially, they already sell audits through AWS Marketplace, so an AWS-native readiness scanner is a natural pre-audit funnel for them: LoxeAI gets clients to audit-ready faster, Advantage keeps its 4-6 week turnaround promise. Peter Case (partnerships) is the warm entry; Gulrajani (AWS Certified) is the technical validator.
pitch_note: Open with the AWS overlap: 'You sell SOC 2 audits on AWS Marketplace; we built an AWS-native scanner that gets your pre-audit prospects most of the way to ready before they ever sign your engagement letter.' Ask for a 20-minute call, then offer to let Gulrajani or an auditor run a LoxeAI scan against their own AWS account or a sandbox — no strings, they judge the evidence quality themselves. If it holds up, they tell pre-audit and Vanta-onboarding clients 'run this scan first — it gets you ~80% ready,' which shortens their readiness phase, protects their fast-turnaround brand, and gives LoxeAI a design-partner auditor whose validation carries weight with lean AWS-native startups.
